There's definitely some things that suck about it.

It feels like they tried to simplify the SPECIAL/perk/skill system , but all it really did was make perks into flat % upgrades rather than interesting mechanics (a few exceptions here and there) and made the SPECIAL stats very one-dimensional.

For instance, before when you had a low Science skill you could pop a Mentat and it might push you just over the threshold you needed to crack a terminal. Some of the remade SPECIAL stats make sense but others feel useless. Having a character with a crazy high Perception used to be awesome, picking out enemies from a long way off and being able to crack safes like nothing. But now Perception only covers your AP pool, which only comes in handy if you rely a lot on VATS.

Is the game garbage? I'd say no. But it is definitely less of a good game than 3 or NV was.
